title: Director of Manufacturing
text:
Rich’s, also known as Rich Products Corporation, is a family-owned food company dedicated to inspiring possibilities. From cakes and icings to pizza, appetizers and specialty toppings, our products are used in homes, restaurants and bakeries around the world. Beyond great food, our customers also gain insights to help them stay competitive, no matter their size. Our portfolio includes creative solutions geared at helping food industry professionals compete in foodservice, retail, in-store bakery, deli, and prepared foods, among others. With more than 13,500 associates working globally in 100 countries and annual sales of $5.9 billion, Rich’s is a global leader with a focus on everything that family makes possible. Rich’s®—Infinite Possibilities. One Family.
 
 
**Purpose Statement**
Provide leadership and overall vision to assigned manufacturing plants in the Desserts category. This position will have multi-site responsibility and will analyze, coach and guide to ensure optimum efficiency, productivity and supply chain improvements.
 
 
**Key Accountabilities And Outcomes**
Full responsibility for the complete operation of the Missouri City and Twinstar manufacturing facilities.
 
 

* Ensures safe, efficient operation of the plant within guidelines by Rich Products and all governmental laws and regulations to include all food safety programs and auditing processes.
* Monitors production, inventory, safety, HR, QA, maintenance, and sanitation programs.
* Plants capital projects, long rage strategic planning, and succession planning.
* Promotes Lean Manufacturing concepts and leads the plants with Rich Products vision; is open to and promotes change to continually improve and enhance the facility and workforce to stay ahead of the competition.
* Ensures ethical behavior in all aspects of managing the facility and its material and human resources.
* Responsible for manufacturing facility’s Capital and operating budgets.
* Responsible for associate and leadership development, developing team skills, and creating a culture of engagement and continuous improvement.
* Develop and implement long term strategies for desserts manufacturing and product lines based on Sales & Marketing projections.
* Understand co-packer capabilities, costs, and quality. Make vs buy recommendations.
* Establish an ongoing capacity review process as the business grows and changes.
* Identify and evaluate opportunities to drive out costs across the plants.
* Facilitate the sharing of desserts best practices across the plants.
* Key Operations gate keeper to work with Desserts CBU to assess the feasibility of new product concepts.
* Explore, propose, and lead the implementation of new process and packaging technology for desserts.
* Provide strong Project Management Skills for category projects

**Knowledge, Skills, And Experience**

* Bachelors Degree in Business Management, Food Science, Engineering, Science or similar academic disciplines.
* 5-10 Years Experience at the Plant Management Position and 7-10 years in a supervisory and or management position with progressively more responsible positions.
* Knowledge of Food Safety, Associate Safety Programs/Systems HAACP, GMPs, etc. Sanitation and Plant Maintenance and Continuous Improvement such as Lean Manufacturing and Total Productive Manufacturing (TPM) would be definite assets.
* A Masters’s in Business Administration is preferred but not required.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills and cultural sensitivity required. Foreign Language skills as it relates to the facility’s demographics are a plus.
* Ability to manage a diverse staff of managerial personnel.
* Experience with self-directed teams/skill-based pay.
* Proven track record of leading cross functional project teams.
* Solid grasp of manufacturing processes and systems.
* This position will be based in Missouri City, Texas.
